words.definition: not used
words.example: Return any unused office supplies to the storage room.
words.exampleTranslation: 請把未使用的辦公用品歸還到儲藏室。

words.definition: to voluntarily give up a right or claim
words.example: The landlord agreed to waive the late fee this month.
words.exampleTranslation: 房東同意這個月豁免逾期費用。

words.definition: the currency of Japan, or a strong desire for something
words.example: The exchange rate for the yen fluctuated last week.
words.exampleTranslation: 上週日圓的匯率有所波動。

words.definition: to make something start working
words.example: Activate your account by clicking the link in the email.
words.exampleTranslation: 點擊電子郵件裡的連結來啟動你的帳戶。

words.definition: in addition; also
words.example: Additionally, the plan includes free technical support.
words.exampleTranslation: 此外，這個方案還包含免費的技術支援。

words.definition: expressing agreement or a positive response
words.example: The board gave an affirmative response to the proposal.
words.exampleTranslation: 董事會對這項提案給出了肯定的答覆。

words.definition: a person who bakes and sells bread
words.example: The baker starts work before dawn every day.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位麵包師傅每天在天亮前就開始工作。

words.definition: to generate ideas through group discussion
words.example: Let's brainstorm some ideas for the new campaign.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們來為新的活動腦力激盪一下想法吧。

words.definition: an enclosure with bars for holding animals
words.example: The delivery included a metal cage for the warehouse.
words.exampleTranslation: 這次的貨物包含一個給倉庫用的金屬籠子。

words.definition: a movie theater
words.example: The mall includes a cinema with ten screens.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間購物中心設有一間十廳的電影院。

words.definition: the act of working together
words.example: The two departments launched a collaboration to improve efficiency.
words.exampleTranslation: 這兩個部門展開合作以提升效率。

words.definition: a residential building where individual units are separately owned
words.example: She purchased a condominium near the business district.
words.exampleTranslation: 她在商業區附近買了一間公寓大廈。

words.definition: following one after another without interruption
words.example: The team has met its sales target for six consecutive months.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個團隊已經連續六個月達成銷售目標。

words.definition: operating without a cord, especially an electrical one
words.example: The office upgraded to cordless phones last year.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間辦公室去年升級到無線電話。

words.definition: luxurious or of superior quality
words.example: Guests can upgrade to a deluxe room for an extra fee.
words.exampleTranslation: 房客可以額外付費升級到豪華客房。

words.definition: worth having or wanting
words.example: The corner office is the most desirable spot on the floor.
words.exampleTranslation: 那間轉角辦公室是這層樓最令人嚮往的位置。

words.definition: a difference between two things that should match
words.example: There is a discrepancy between the invoice and the purchase order.
words.exampleTranslation: 發票和採購單之間有出入。

words.definition: to send someone or something off for a purpose
words.example: The company will dispatch a technician within 24 hours.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家公司會在 24 小時內派遣一位技術人員過去。

words.definition: a disadvantage of a plan or situation
words.example: The only drawback of the new system is its high cost.
words.exampleTranslation: 這套新系統唯一的缺點是成本高。

words.definition: not interesting, or not sharp or bright
words.example: The meeting felt dull without any new information to discuss.
words.exampleTranslation: 這場會議因為沒有新資訊可討論而顯得無趣。
